summary: The Decider Store — new Main-Factor/Sub-Factor architecture: 10/10 backend pytest PASS and full frontend flow verified. Backend: (a) GET /api/decider-store/import-template.xlsx returns HTTP 200, spreadsheetml, with EXACTLY two sheets ['Template Data','Instructions'] and col-A labels 'Main Factor'/'Sub-Factor' present; (b) POST /api/decider-store/import/excel (super@test.com admin token) uploading the freshly downloaded template parses to 3 factors × 2 options with per-factor sub_factors[] (Org Type → Solo %/Startup %/SME %/Corporate %, split %s summing to 100 exactly), and every option value is {raw,num} keyed by sub_factor.id (AFFILIATION → Solo %=100.0 verified); (c) uploading an OLD collapsed-string sheet ('Values (with suitability%)') returns a clean HTTP 400 with a human message referencing the Main-Factor / Sub-Factor template — no crash; (d) GET /api/decider-store/bmp-55-patterns returns 10 factors with 28 total sub-factors + 54 options, values dict keyed by sub-factor id with {raw,num} shape; (e) POST /clone {mode:'full'} creates a MyDezider decision with 28 factors (one per sub-factor, display name 'Org Type — Solo %') + 54 options; assessments carry percentage=None + unit_value(str) + num_value(numeric present); (f) POST /clone {mode:'values_only'} creates factors with category='' and rating=0 (classification stripped) — 54 options still populated; (g) POST /bmp-55-patterns/push-to-stores returns solutions=54, reviews=54; (h) POST /bmp-55-patterns/sync-from-stores returns options=54 (int); (i) both push/sync return 401/403 unauthenticated. Frontend (390×844 mobile viewport, super@test.com via /admin/login): PUBLIC /decider-store lists the LIVE BMP card (Free · 10 factors · 54 options); /decider-store/bmp-55-patterns detail renders Factors block showing each MAIN factor followed by 'Solo % · Startup % · SME % · Corporate %' style sub-factor chips (Qual tag). Admin /admin/decider-store toolbar: Excel template · Import Excel · Import Google Sheet · Build from Solution Store; BMP card exposes Classify · Edit Data · Push to Stores · Sync · Unpublish · Delete. 'Edit Data' modal opens with 'Edit option values' header and per-sub-factor numeric inputs grouped under each main factor (e.g. AFFILIATION → Org Type[Qual] → Solo %(split 25%)=100, Startup %(split 25%)=40, SME %(split 25%)=blank, Corporate %(split 25%)=blank; Solution Category → Product %(split 50%)=100 …) with a 'Save option values' button. 'Classify' modal renders all 10 main factors with Mandatory/Optional segmented toggle, +/- priority stepper, Quantitative/Qualitative type toggle, and a Sub-factors block showing each sub-factor with an editable Split % TextInput and a running total 'Split total 100% ✓' (or '(should be 100%)') — split integrity indicator verified for every factor.

issues: Two Sub-factors ('Intensity …' and 'Affordability') display 'Split total 99.99% ✓'. Purely cosmetic — the seed uses 33.33 × 3. The tolerance in the UI (Math.abs(sum-100)<=0.5) already accepts this as ✓, but consider auto-rebalancing the last row so display reads a clean 100%.

action_items: (Optional / cosmetic) Normalize per-sub-factor split_pct in the seed so the Classify modal shows a clean '100% ✓' instead of '99.99% ✓' for Intensity & Affordability (currently 33.33 × 3).
critical_code_review_comments: core/decider_import.py cleanly separates label detection (Main Factor / Sub-Factor / Category / Priority / Data Type / UI Object / Split %) from header row (No / Option Name / …) with forward-fill across merged main-factor cells — robust against openpyxl returning None for merged non-anchor cells.

core/decider_import.parse_import raises ValueError with a helpful message ('This sheet isn\'t in the new Main-Factor / Sub-Factor format. Download the latest Excel template …') which is surfaced verbatim by routes/decider_store.import_excel as HTTP 400 — good UX for admins uploading the OLD format.

core/decider_import.parse_import auto-equalises split_pct when the column is entirely blank and only WARNS (not raises) when totals ±1% of 100 — the seed's 33.33×3 case correctly triggers no warning; but 99.99 vs 100.00 display drift shows up in the admin Classify modal (see design_issues).

routes/decider_store._build_decision_from_template flattens sub_factors → per-sub-factor MyDezider factors (display 'Main — Sub'); sid_to_new mapping correctly re-keys option assessments so num_value/unit_value survive the clone. clone_mode & source_template_id are recorded on the decision.

routes/decider_store._push_template_to_stores uses sub-factor id as solution.quantitative_factors.factor_id AND as review_net.baseline_profile key — the sync-from-stores reverse path relies on this identity; keep it stable when refactoring.
frontend/app/admin/decider-store.tsx line 626-628 uses Math.abs(sum-100)<=0.5 for the split total ✓ indicator (matches the backend's ±1% tolerance) — consistent.
MongoDB _id is projected out via {'_id':0} in GET /decider-store/{template_id} and in solution/baseline reads — no ObjectId leak.

Test selector caveat: on /admin/decider-store the header instruction line 'Classify factors → it goes live in the public store.' matches 'Classify' as substring — playwright had to use get_by_text('Classify', exact=True) to hit the card button. Consider adding testID='btn-classify-<template_id>' for the toolbar buttons.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (public list + detail + admin Classify + Edit Data modals all render with sub-factor semantics)

seed_data_creation: None new. Used existing seeded 'bmp-55-patterns' template. push-to-stores side-effect re-created 54 STRATEGY solutions + 54 ReviewNet baselines (idempotent — safe re-run). No cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_decider_store_subfactor_v2.py is the canonical NEW-format test suite. Reads BASE_URL from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Auth via super@test.com/SuperPass2026! → Bearer session_token. Full-clone factor count for bmp-55-patterns = 28 (10 main × their sub-factors). If seed changes, `sum(len(f.sub_factors) for f in factors)` must remain ≥20 for the clone test to pass. push_to_stores expects solutions>0 AND reviews>0 (currently 54/54 — all 10 seed factors are qualitative so every option produces a baseline). Old-collapsed-format check uploads a minimal 2-cell workbook and asserts 400 with a message mentioning 'Main-Factor' or 'template'. Admin selector tip: use get_by_text('Classify', exact=True) or add testID — 'Classify' also appears in the instruction row.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects. One minor frontend playwright selector gotcha (the substring 'Classify' matches the instructions text line); resolved with exact=True.
